oceansideTide.detail: NOAA CO-OPS returned no hilo predictions for 9410396 at MLLW and at MSL. The curve is La Jolla 9410230. No harbor offset is applied.

mopForecast.note: A MOP forecast file is published beside each nowcast. The 48-hour strip uses it and does not apply the buoy ratio. Bias-corrected ECMWF WAM is the fallback when that file is missing.

breaks.name: Oceanside Harbor
breaks.note: Jetty. Wants more north in the swell than the beaches south of it.
breaks.tideNote: prefers mid. More sensitive to direction than to the exact hour of the tide.

breaks.name: Oceanside Pier
breaks.note: Beachbreak. Afternoon sea breeze is onshore.
breaks.tideNote: prefers mid. Tide is a tie-breaker, not the session.
